title: Oh Jesus You're my
lyrics_original: Oh! Jesus, you’re my Heavenly Father
You're my one and only caretaker
I sing for you, Lord! I thank you always (2)
You protected me from each and every trouble
Now bless and guide me to be more fruitful (2)
I sing for you, Lord! I thank you always (2)
I humbly pray that you bless my new age
I pray that you go before me all the way (2)
I sing for you, Lord! I thank you always (2)
If you're not there nothing is achievable
Give me the wisdom to be more usable (2)
I sing for you Lord! I thank you always!! (2)
Oh! Jesus, you’re my Heavenly Father
You're my one and only caretaker
I sing for you, Lord! I thank you always (2)

bible_verses.telugu: ఏలయనగా మనకు శిశువు పుట్టెను మనకు కుమారుడు అనుగ్రహింపబడెను ఆయన భుజముమీద రాజ్యభారముండును. ఆశ్చర్యకరుడు ఆలోచనకర్త బలవంతుడైన దేవుడు నిత్యుడగు తండ్రి సమాధానకర్తయగు అధిపతి అని  అతనికి పేరు పెట్టబడును.
bible_verses.english: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

bible_verses.telugu: ఏ అపాయమును రాకుండ యెహోవా నిన్ను కాపా డును ఆయన నీ ప్రాణమును కాపాడును ఇది మొదలుకొని నిరంతరము నీ రాకపోకలయందు యెహోవా నిన్ను కాపాడును
bible_verses.english: The Lord will keep you from all harm—he will watch over your life; the Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

bible_verses.telugu: ద్రాక్షావల్లిని నేను, తీగెలు మీరు. ఎవడు నాయందు నిలిచియుండునో నేను ఎవనియందు నిలిచి యుందునో వాడు బహుగా ఫలించును; నాకు వేరుగా ఉండి మీరేమియు చేయలేరు.
bible_verses.english: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my faithful caretaker and constant protector. You have brought me safely through every trouble, and my heart fills with endless gratitude for Your loving presence. As I step into this new season, please go before me and guide my steps. Root me deeply in Your love so that my life may bear much fruit for Your glory. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my faithful caretaker and constant protector. You have brought me safely through every trouble, and my heart fills with endless gratitude for Your loving presence. As I step into this new season, please go before me and guide my steps. Root me deeply in Your love so that my life may bear much fruit for Your glory. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Jesus is our faithful caretaker and protector through every season of life. As we reflect on His past deliverances, our hearts naturally overflow with continuous praise and gratitude. Stepping into a new season, we can rest assured that He goes before us, guiding our steps to bear fruitful lives in Him. This song warmly invites us to surrender our future to His loving hands and lift up a joyful song of praise to the One who holds us close.
